Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II access + auditor review role

Hi Soojin,

Hope you’re well. Acme is preparing for our annual vendor security review. Can you provision access to Redwood’s SOC 2 Type II report and associated evidence in your trust portal for our external auditor (SecureAudit LLP)? They will need reviewer-level access to download evidence.

Details:
- Auditor: Laura Kent, SecureAudit LLP (laura.kent@secureaudit.com)
- Reviewer access required for evidence download and log review
- Preferred access window: 21 days (we understand default links sometimes expire earlier)
- Please confirm the audited period covered by your latest SOC 2 Type II (start/end dates). If it doesn’t cover Acme’s assessment window (Jan 1 2026 - Jun 30 2026), we will need a bridge letter or confirmation of controls after the report period.

Also attaching a lightweight SIG request form for scope notes. Let me know if you need an engagement letter from SecureAudit before you grant access.

Thanks,
Hannah Cole
Security Operations Manager
Acme Analytics

Hi Hannah 9and thanks for the details.

Short answers up front: we can invite SecureAudit with a reviewer role and we can extend the portal access window to 21 days; we typically require an auditor engagement letter before granting download permissions. Our latest SOC 2 Type II covers 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. If your assessment window extends into 2026, we can provide a bridge letter that covers the gap between the report end date and the date of your review (standard wording, signed by our compliance lead).

Next steps I propose:
- Please have SecureAudit send a signed engagement letter to compliance@redwood.ai (or confirm they will sign the copy you attach).
- Please confirm the exact auditor account email (you listed laura.kent@secureaudit.com) and whether they will use an SSO account or personal email.
- Once we have the engagement letter we will: provision reviewer-level access (21-day window), enable evidence downloads, and record the access in the audit log.

I’m cc’ing Marissa (Trust) and Rishi (AE) for awareness. I’ll draft the bridge-letter and share internally for signature once we confirm scope.

Attaching: portal-invite-stub.txt (will be replaced with the live invite link after approval)

Regards,
Soojin Lee
